<script>
    function updateCarouselControlsVisibility(carousel) {
        let activeCarouselItem = carousel.querySelector('.carousel-item.active');
        let carouselControlNext = carousel.querySelector('.carousel-control-next');
        let carouselControlPrev = carousel.querySelector('.carousel-control-prev');

        if (activeCarouselItem && activeCarouselItem.classList.contains('remove-next')) {
            carouselControlNext.classList.add('d-none');
            carouselControlNext.classList.remove('d-flex');
        } else {
            carouselControlNext.classList.remove('d-none');
            carouselControlNext.classList.add('d-flex');
        }

        if (activeCarouselItem && activeCarouselItem.classList.contains('remove-prev')) {
            carouselControlPrev.classList.add('d-none');
            carouselControlPrev.classList.remove('d-flex');
        } else {
            carouselControlPrev.classList.remove('d-none');
            carouselControlPrev.classList.add('d-flex');
        }
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.webstories').forEach((carousel) => {
        let carouselObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
            const classMutations = mutations.filter((mutation) => mutation.attributeName === 'class');

            if (classMutations.length > 0) {
                updateCarouselControlsVisibility(carousel);
            }
        });

        carousel.querySelectorAll('.carousel-item').forEach((item) => {
            carouselObserver.observe(item, {
                attributes: true,
                attributeFilter: ['class']
            });
        });

        let carouselControls = carousel.querySelectorAll('.carousel-control-next, .carousel-control-prev');

        carouselControls.forEach((control) => {
            control.addEventListener('click', () => updateCarouselControlsVisibility(carousel));
        });

        updateCarouselControlsVisibility(carousel);
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function() {

        var numItems = $carousel.children().length;

        if (numItems > 1) {
            $('#banner-carousel-D9LhHlCGnom8-webstory').slick({
                slidesToShow: 1,
                slidesToScroll: 1,
                arrows: true,
                prevArrow: '<button type="button" class="slick-prev position-absolute d-flex align-items-center border-0"><i class="fas fa-fast-backward text-white"></i></button>',
                nextArrow: '<button type="button" class="slick-next position-absolute d-flex align-items-center border-0"><i class="fas fa-fast-forward text-white"></i></button>',
                infinite: false
            });

            $('#banner-carousel-D9LhHlCGnom8-webstory').on('beforeChange', function(event, slick, currentSlide, nextSlide) {
                // Disable prev button when on the first item
                if (nextSlide === 0) {
                    $('.slick-prev').prop('disabled', true);
                } else {
                    $('.slick-prev').prop('disabled', false);
                }

                // Disable next button when on the last item
                if (nextSlide === slick.slideCount - 1) {
                    $('.slick-next').prop('disabled', true);
                } else {
                    $('.slick-next').prop('disabled', false);
                }
            });

            $('#banner-carousel-D9LhHlCGnom8-webstory').slick('slickSetOption', 'autoplay', false, true);
            $('.slick-prev').css('left', '10%');
            $('.slick-prev').css('top', '50%');
            $('.slick-prev').css('z-index', '1');
            $('.slick-next').css('right', '10%');
            $('.slick-next').css('top', '50%');
            $('.slick-next').css('z-index', '1');
            $('.slick-nav-item').on('click', function() {
                var slideIndex = $(this).data('slick-index');
                $('#banner-carousel-D9LhHlCGnom8-webstory').slick('slickGoTo', slideIndex);

        } else if (numItems === 1) {

            });
            $carousel.children().first().css({
                position: 'relative',
                display: 'block',
                width: '100%'
            });
        }
    });

    function addModalOpenClass() {
        $('html').addClass('modal-open');
    }

    function removeModalOpenClass() {
        $('html').removeClass('modal-open');
    }

    var observerConfig = {
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['class'],
        childList: false,
        subtree: false
    };

    function classChangeCallback(mutationsList, observer) {
        mutationsList.forEach(function(mutation) {
            if (mutation.target === document.body && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
                var bodyClasses = $(document.body).attr('class');
                if (bodyClasses.includes('modal-open')) {
                    addModalOpenClass();
                } else {
                    removeModalOpenClass();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    var observer = new MutationObserver(classChangeCallback);
    observer.observe(document.body, observerConfig);

    var closeButton = document.querySelector('.btn-modal-close');

    closeButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var divs = document.querySelectorAll('div[class^="mobile-story-"]');
        divs.forEach(function(div) {
            div.classList.add('d-none');

    });
